name: Remak-Energomontaz S.A.
summary: Remak-Energomontaz S.A. specializes in the modernization and repair of steam and water boilers, serving clients both in Poland and across international markets. Its expertise extends to the installation of various energy infrastructure, including power equipment, flue gas desulphurization (FGD) systems, electrostatic precipitators, and industrial pipelines. Additionally, the firm handles the refurbishment and construction of power plants, focusing on critical components like pressure vessels and steam pipelines, and provides comprehensive repair services for pressure equipment. Further offerings include destructive and non-destructive testing (NDT), specialized welding and radiographic inspections, the development of bespoke repair technologies, and the installation and maintenance of diverse industrial installations. Founded in 1970, Remak-Energomontaz S.A. is headquartered in Warszawa, Poland.
